title: Zanoni
author: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron
description: "Zanoni" by Baron Edward Bulwer Lytton Lytton is a novel published in 1842.
longDescription: It tells the story of Zanoni, a mysterious immortal who has lived since ancient Chaldean times and possesses occult powers through Rosicrucian wisdom.

authorInfo.bio: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron (1803–1873) is the author of Rienzi, the Last of the Roman Tribunes. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
works: Rienzi, the Last of the Roman Tribunes
